role_raw: thermo-optic phase shifter (single-waveguide with integrated heater)
query: phase_shifter heater thermal eo tuning pi Low-loss, low-power thermo-optic phase shifter. Devices are placed in an array with center-to-center pitch along +y. Optical path oriented parallel across the array (same propagation direction for all eight). Include integrated heater and electrical routing/pads within this block (do not break out heater as separate component). Specify target phase tuning range (e.g., ≥2π) and electrical constraints (max power/voltage/current) during implementation. 8x Thermo-Optic Phase Shifter Array (Parallel, Y-Directed) An array of eight low-loss, low-power thermo-optic phase shifters arranged in parallel along the y direction (i.e., repeated devices spaced in y). Each phase shifter is a single waveguide phase shifter with integrated heater and electrical access. Eight low-loss, low-power thermo-optic phase shifters in a y-direction parallel array; each provides controllable optical phase delay (target tuning range to be defined, commonly up to ≥2π).
